name: compaction-preamble
purpose: Measure compaction that loses the whole preamble, on the directory route. A first turn reads the mandatory and relevant guidance, writes a Bash script and stops for required input from the human. The same managed process then compacts with instructions that keep only the caller's task. The answer of the human follows, and it gives no recovery reminder. The descriptor variable stays set in the harness environment.

compaction.instructions: Summarise only the instruction to load the grove-impl skill and everything after it: the leaf, the work done, the open question for the human and the exact ending commands. Leave out everything before that instruction, also where an earlier rule asks a summary to keep it. Write no other absolute path and no hexadecimal digest.
